gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-rokkitt: Rokkitt brings a bookish, classic serif warmth with its wide-open c. Bellota Text above it is the more commanding of the two, its ribbon-like strokes never thinning anywhere, so the pair feels like a shout followed by a nod.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sanchez: Distinctive and a bit bold, Bellota Text has round bowls that never thin at the sides. Sanchez follows as a dignified serif, its calipers-style c giving a long stretch of text a steady, bookish walk.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-solway: Bellota Text leads with open, commanding letters and no calligraphic shading to steer the eye. Solway is the classic serif that backs it up, flat and authoritative, with a generous opening into the e.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-yuji-boku: Yuji Boku reads dignified and editorial, every stroke like a drawn cable. Bellota Text sits over it with a commanding, distinctive openness, and the two share the page without either one crowding the other.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-dm-sans: DM Sans is the friendly one here, with wide-set terminals on its s. Bruno Ace brings ruler-drawn lines and diagonals as thick as its uprights, so the pairing has a stark, expressive character against that approachable body.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-fs-paquito: Paquito is confident and approachable, with almost no gap between its lowercase and its caps. Bruno Ace holds the top with its ruler-straight, lingering rhythm, and over a long page the body keeps things friendly while the heading stays strange.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-aleo: Aleo reads as a dignified text serif, with counters that let the eye slip in and out easily. Bruno Ace, with no thick-thin shifts at all, sits above it as a sharp, expressive counterpoint that makes a longer read feel unhurried.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-almendra-sc: Bruno Ace draws its bowls at stem thickness and keeps its counters connected to the outside, which feels distinctive and expressive. Pick a sensible size for Almendra SC, the classic serif.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-antic-slab: Bruno Ace lingers on each character, one beat per letter, drawn with a ruler-straight line. And Antic Slab, a dignified text serif with round bowls and wide s curves, gives that rhythm an editorial footing.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-arvo: Bruno Ace draws every stroke at one thickness, ruler-straight and expressive. Arvo, a dignified text serif whose curves refuse to close, is the quality that makes the pair feel traditional and strange at once.
